WITH transaction_trader AS (
  SELECT tr.transreg, td.tradekind
  FROM advancedbehavior ab
  JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg
  JOIN trader td ON tr.trdref = td.tradereg
), counts AS (
  SELECT tradekind, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
  FROM transaction_trader
  GROUP BY tradekind
)
SELECT tradekind,
       transaction_count,
       transaction_count::numeric / SUM(transaction_count) OVER () AS share_of_total,
       AVG(transaction_count) OVER () AS average_count,
       AVG(transaction_count::numeric / SUM(transaction_count) OVER ()) OVER () AS average_share
FROM counts;
